english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a place or building that has been deserted and is no longer maintained.
Use this as the default choice for property that has been left unused or neglected and has fallen into disrepair.
Use this for a forlorn place, building, or piece of land that has been abandoned and left unused.

examples.english: This cinema has been abandoned for many years.
examples.traditional: 呢間戲院荒廢咗好多年。
